# National Pitching

> > National Pitching (NPA) provides science-based pitching training, velocity development, and coach certification programs founded by legendary pitching coach Tom House.

The National Pitching Association delivers comprehensive training through S.T.A.T clinics (Screen, Test, Assess, Train), weighted ball protocols, and biomechanics education. Their system has trained MLB pitchers including Nolan Ryan, Jose Berrios, and Shane Greene, and offers certification programs for coaches through Tom House Sports LLC.

## Key Topics

- National Pitching Association (NPA)
- Tom House - founder and legendary pitching coach
- S.T.A.T Clinics - Screen, Test, Assess, Train methodology
- Velocity development and capacity testing
- Pitching biomechanics and mechanics
- Weighted ball training protocols
- Youth pitcher development
- Coach certification programs
- Torque and trunk rotation mechanics
- MLB pitcher training (Nolan Ryan, Jose Berrios, Shane Greene)
- Injury prevention and arm health
- Performance nutrition for pitchers
- National Pitching Alumni showcase

## Training Programs & Clinics

- [S.T.A.T Pitching Clinics by National Pitching | Pitching Lessons](https://www.nationalpitching.com/stat-clinics): 3-day Screen, Test, Assess, Train clinics for velocity capacity testing
- [Athlete and Coach Performance Clinic - COACH - National Pitching Tom House Sports LLC](https://www.nationalpitching.com/product/coach-training-clinic): 3-day NPA certification clinic with Master Coaches in El Segundo, CA

## Pitching Mechanics & Performance

- [Torque – 80% of Pitching Velocity | National Pitching](https://www.nationalpitching.com/blog/torque-80%25-pitching-velocity): Torque mechanics & trunk rotation's role in pitching velocity generation
- [Youth Pitching: Improving Timing for Success | National Pitching](https://www.nationalpitching.com/blog/youth-pitching-improving-timing): Youth pitching fundamentals focusing on timing & foot strike mechanics
